study type: Prospective Cohort with Instrumental Variable Analysis
cohort: The study cohort consisted of mothers expected to give birth in 2022 in the Republic of Korea, whose data were extracted from the Korean Early Childhood Education & Care Panel.
finding: Immediate skin-to-skin contact positively influenced exclusive breastfeeding rates, making mothers 36.3% more likely to exclusively breastfeed at 1 month postpartum, and 26.9% and 26.2% more likely at 2 and 3 months, respectively.
